resources.string: A workspace that fits your window.
Open a document to start editing. Resize the window to try the adaptive layout.
Starter documents · Edits survive window recreation. They are not saved to disk.
This starter uses Material 3 Adaptive to follow the available window space, including desktop windows, tablets, foldables, and phones.
Wide windows show the document list beside the editor. Narrow windows show one pane at a time, with Back returning to the list.
Tab moves between controls. Enter opens a focused document. Text supports pointer selection, scrolling, and standard editing shortcuts.
Document navigation and edits survive window recreation. This is a development sample; add persistent storage before using it for real documents.
